mentions.name: UltimaDB
mentions.description: A high-performance, full-featured MVCC transactional embedded database with a special focus for use on SMR clusters. It provides full transactions, selectable persistence modes (in-memory, eventual, strict) and consistency levels (snapshot isolation and serializable snapshot isolation), with heavy focus on performance. Written in Rust (~8k lines of code, 15k lines of tests, 96% coverage); formal verification with Lean 4 and consistency checking with elle/jepsen are in progress.
